titleText: Son discovers his father found body of woman killed in 1936 storm
mainText: From Times of Malta: Son discovers his father found body of woman killed in 1936 storm. Leonard Callus was shocked to discover his father’s involvement in the 90-year-old tragedy while going through archival records

titleText: Cultural watchdog calls for archaeological evaluation for Marsa football stadium
mainText: From Times of Malta: Cultural watchdog calls for archaeological evaluation for Marsa football stadium. Watchdog’s tone different in nearby ground project

titleText: PM defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges
mainText: From The Malta Independent: PM defends Malta’s economic model, says country remains resilient amid European challenges. Prime Minister Robert Abela has defended the government's economic model, insisting that Malta continues to perform strongly despite the economic challenges facing countries across Europe.

titleText: Robert Abela defends foreign worker measures, accuses Opposition of double standards
mainText: From MaltaToday: Robert Abela defends foreign worker measures, accuses Opposition of double standards. Measures imposing new financial burdens on non-EU workers are “calibrated and just”, Robert Abela told parliament on Monday evening, rejecting accusations of discrimination and racism.

titleText: Borg accuses Abela, Caruana of failing to understand workers, says they are ‘used to luxury’
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Borg accuses Abela, Caruana of failing to understand workers, says they are ‘used to luxury’. Opposition Leader Alex Borg accused Prime Minister Robert Abela and Finance Minister Clyde Caruana of being out of touch with ordinary workers, arguing that they cannot understand the financial pressures facing Maltese families because they are “used to luxury”.
